_about: MIXING BLOCKS: PATTERNS, PATCH SIZE AND SOFT EDGES.
A list mixes its blocks in equal shares. Repeat a block for more shares: [a, a, b] is two thirds a.
pattern: blobs = patches (the default), bands = stripes that run along the stream, speckle = a random pick per block.
scale: the patch size or stripe width, in percent of the stream's width (default 30). Never finer than 2 blocks.
edge_noise: how softly a ring's outer edge blends into the next ring. 0 = a sharp line, 1 = very soft (default 0.3).
minecraft:air in a list leaves that share as the ground was, so a ring can thin out into the land.
